routingPolicy: Domain IDs are editorial navigation entry points, not official code equivalences, programme assignments, exhaustive subject membership or evidence of teaching. An unspecified or residual code never proves which particular subjects a programme covers. Topic-level evidence is required before creating lessons or assigning more precise routes.

routingKinds.subject: Named source category; the atlas selects useful editorial homes without certifying instruction.
routingKinds.not-further-defined: The source identifies only the stated broader scope. Do not infer a detailed field or treat missing detail as interdisciplinary study.
routingKinds.not-elsewhere-classified: A residual within the stated scope. A particular topic must be inspected before assigning a more precise atlas route; this is not an all-subjects wildcard.
routingKinds.interdisciplinary: Route by the named leading broad field; do not infer the other component fields or create prerequisite edges without actual programme content.
routingKinds.main-class: Main-class library outline only. Subclasses, schedules and item-level call numbers have not been audited.
routingKinds.provisional-cultural-domain: Discovery route from the earlier indexed overview only. Body access is stopped; community context and permissions remain unresolved.
routingKinds.unknown: Administrative unknown-field value; deliberately excluded from domain and coverage claims.
